findings: New raw lines 5-431 retain the full Boleto invoice guide and its collection-method decision table, customer and payment method setup, product/price, Dashboard and API invoicing paths, finalization and send operations. Unlike an index-only capture, the November body adds runnable example branches; compare with old raw lines 4-396 rather than infer from length or code syntax.

Substantive new coverage: new raw lines 77-120,126-218 provide explicit customer-configured Accounts v2 versus Customers v1 creation, Boleto PaymentMethod attachment with customer_account versus customer, and Accounts v2 configuration.customer.billing.default_payment_method versus Customers v1 invoice_settings.default_payment_method. Old raw lines 8-14 already named Accounts v2 availability in prose but lines 80-185 showed only Customers v1 Node examples. The new branches have distinct identities and dated preview/version conditions, not a universal replacement of Customers v1.

New raw lines 324-406 add Accounts v2 invoice-item and invoice examples with customer_account for both send_invoice and charge_automatically, alongside Customers v1 customer examples. Old raw lines 299-365 supplied Customers v1 Node examples for those same collection methods. Most Node-to-curl changes, Dashboard step renumbering, and minor link/copy changes are presentation/example-format changes; do not treat syntax alone as a new behavioral guarantee.

New raw lines 9 and 77 explicitly require enabling Boleto for the integration and attaching a payment method before automatically charging; old raw lines 16, 20, 127-185 and decision-table lines 28-34 already describe Boleto setup and customer default. Current source lines 19-21 say no explicit PM needed for charge_automatically, which could mislead unless it says the invoice example omits an explicit payment method because a Boleto default must already be attached.

Both captures require the billing email setting (new raw lines 11-13; old raw lines 18-20). Their collection table separates send_invoice when customer details or default method are absent from charge_automatically when name, address, tax ID and default Boleto method are present; invoice due date and voucher expiration are distinct, with a three-day default voucher expiration (new raw lines 15-27; old raw lines 22-34). The summary lines 13-25 omit these prerequisites and time boundaries.

Both captures say charge_automatically invoices still require the customer to pay the Boleto voucher and receive a payment link (new raw lines 296-310; old raw lines 271-284). Invoice creation, auto-finalization, voucher generation, and customer payment are separate states. New raw lines 318-320 and old raw lines 291-295 make auto_advance=true an example for later automatic finalization, while new raw lines 364 and 409 and old raw lines 329 and 368 say auto_advance=false permits editing until finalization by Dashboard, send, pay, or finalize API. Current source line 23 overstates that false means manual finalization required.

Current source line 27 says invoice finalization sends an invoice email. New raw lines 418-426 and old raw lines 380-391 instead say sending an invoice finalizes it; auto-finalization in a sandbox does not send emails (new raw lines 318-320; old raw lines 291-295). Correct the direction of implication and preserve the legal-document qualification for finalization, avoiding an email guarantee from finalization alone.

Current source line 13 restricts this guide to one-off invoices, but new raw lines 21-27 and 31 mention invoices for subscription service periods, while both old and new show manual one-off invoice creation (old raw lines 28-38,255-295; new raw lines 21-31,280-320). Describe Boleto invoice collection generally, including recurring subscription-generated invoices where the guide mentions them, without presenting this as the separate subscription setup guide.

Related concept wiki/concepts/stripe-vouchers.md lines 41-55 and 111-117 already routes to this Boleto invoice source and states charge_automatically still requires voucher payment. No concept prose correction follows automatically; any source adjustment should preserve that reciprocal route.
substantive_changes: New raw lines 77-120,126-218 versus old raw lines 8-14,80-185: Accounts v2 moves from availability prose to concrete customer creation, PaymentMethod attach and default-billing examples, with a separate Customers v1 branch and preview-version qualification.

historical_claims_to_preserve: Old raw lines 8-14 already said Accounts v2 was generally available for Connect users and public preview for other Stripe users; new raw lines 79-85 repeat that dated availability and add preview-version/setup details, without proving any account's present eligibility.

Old raw lines 18-34 and new raw lines 11-27: email-setting prerequisite, send_invoice versus charge_automatically choices, name/address/tax ID and default method, separate invoice due date versus Boleto expiration with three-day default.

Old raw lines 127-185: Customers v1 Node examples created and attached Boleto PaymentMethod and set invoice_settings.default_payment_method. New raw lines 154-218 retain Customers v1 equivalents alongside Accounts v2, so preserve the older route.
Old raw lines 271-284 and new raw lines 296-310: charge_automatically still requires the customer to pay the voucher; an invoice or voucher is not proof of funds or payment success.

Old raw lines 291-339,368-391 and new raw lines 316-371,409-426: invoice item and collection method setup, auto_advance example and editable-draft/finalization/send state distinctions, sandbox email qualification, and finalized invoice legal-document warning.

conflicts: Current source line 21 'no explicit PM needed' is narrower only if referring to the invoice create call, while new raw lines 77 and 154-218 require attachment and default Boleto setup for automatic collection; the source should show the prerequisite.
Current source line 23 'manual finalization required' conflicts with new raw lines 364 and 409 and old raw lines 329 and 368, which also allow sending or paying a draft to finalize it.
Current source line 27 reverses the documented relation: new raw lines 418-426 and old raw lines 380-391 say send finalizes; new raw lines 318-320 say sandbox auto-finalization does not send emails.

The Dashboard text new raw line 300 and old raw line 274 says 'immediately charges' an on-file method, while new raw line 310 and old raw line 284 explicitly say the customer still must pay the Boleto for success. Preserve the voucher-payment qualification against literal auto-debit inference.
unresolved_questions: The capture does not test Accounts v2 preview access, live email delivery, voucher payment, or payout; the new sample request/version and product/price example alone cannot establish those outcomes.

source_assessments.reason: The November capture adds substantive Accounts v2 examples and retains the Customer v1 path, while the current summary omits that delta and contains material invoice state/prerequisite overstatements. A source correction is necessary; no canonical page is edited by this review.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/set-up-invoices, new raw lines 9-27 and 77-218 document Boleto enablement, confirmation-link email setting, send_invoice versus charge_automatically, and customer identity/payment-method setup; new raw lines 324-426 then show invoice creation and state transitions. Compared with old raw lines 8-34, 80-185 and 299-391, the new full capture adds explicit Accounts v2 customer_account, default-billing and invoice examples while retaining Customers v1. Sending can finalize an invoice, but finalization and voucher creation are separate from customer payment. source-stripe-boleto-invoices.md preserves the voucher-payment caveat but misses Accounts v2 and overstates payment-method, auto_advance and email/finalization behavior.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto/set-up-invoices, new raw lines 77-218 and 324-406 substantively add Accounts v2 examples with preview/version and customer_account boundaries; old raw lines 8-14 and 80-185 already contained dated Accounts v2 availability prose and Customers v1 examples. Node-to-curl formatting, Dashboard renumbering and link wording are presentational. source-stripe-boleto-invoices.md should retain the historical email setting, collection table, Customers v1 path, due-date versus three-day voucher-expiration distinction and must-pay-voucher qualification. Its line 21 needs the attached-default-method prerequisite, line 23 must allow send/pay/finalize routes when auto_advance is false, and line 27 must say sending finalizes, not that all finalization sends email. The Dashboard 'immediately charges' wording is bounded by the explicit voucher-payment requirement; neither invoice creation nor finalization proves payment.
